_comment: Alfheim 2013-11-28 stitched panorama (4450x2000). `camera` is a tilted-cylinder model fitted 2026-09-15 on 14 hand-read pitch landmarks (residuals mostly < 40 px): pitch metres (X 0..105 = left goal line -> right goal line IN THE PANORAMA, Y 0..68 = far touchline -> near touchline) -> panorama px via projectPitch() in scripts/lib/alfheim.mjs / server telemetry. `zxy` maps the ZXY sensor frame onto that pitch frame (X = zx, Y = 68 - zy) and gives the sensor clock's lead over the video clock (+4.0 s, from the ball-to-nearest-Tromso-player sweep). `px` holds derived reference polygons for humans; consumers derive their own from `camera`.
anchors: see scratch fit_camera.py ANCHORS (corners, centre spot, halfway ends, left penalty box corners, right penalty box near side line, centre circle extremes)
